High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
The case diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.

This is the first application filed u/S.439 of Cr.P.C.
by the petitioner for grant of bail.

The petitioner has been arrested on 07.06.2024 by Police Station Sohagpur, District Narmadapuram in connection with Crime No.322/2024 registered in relation to offences punishable u/S.376(2)(n), 109 and 506 of IPC and Sections 5 and 6 of POCSO Act.
The petitioner who is a woman aged about 21 years is alleged with abetment of rape.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the application.

Considering the fact that the petitioner is in custody since 07.06.2024 and investigation is still going on and the fact that the petitioner is a woman, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that Petitioner- Diksha Patel be released 2 MCRC-24830-2024 on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five Thousand only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of concerned Trial Court.

This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the petitioner :-
